label: Causal
explanation: We tried to tell contacted customers from held-back ones using the details in your file and could not do better than a guessing score of 0.49 (0.50 is chance; our limit is 0.60), so the two groups look randomly chosen. The difference between them can be read as what the campaign changed.
notes: Every customer in the assignment file was compared, whether or not they were meant to be reached (the usual way to read a campaign: the groups as they were chosen).
